summary: solidtime is a self-hosted time tracking application designed for freelancers and agencies. It provides a centralised web interface to log billable hours and monitor project timelines. The codebase is distributed under the AGPL-3.0 licence and is hosted in a public repository.
goodFor: Freelancers and small agency teams who want to self-host their billing and time-tracking infrastructure rather than relying on third-party SaaS tools.
watchOut: The AGPL-3.0 licence imposes strong copyleft requirements if you modify the code and offer it as a service to external users. It also faces competition from many established time-tracking platforms in this category.
deployNotes: Deployment is handled via Docker, which typically requires configuring persistent storage volumes for your data and placing the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
